> You don't need to fill in every section. Just explain the idea as clearly as you can.

## What would you like to add or change?
Describe the feature or improvement.

## Why would it be useful?
What problem would it solve or what would it make easier?

## How would you like it to work?
Describe how you imagine the feature working.

## Search examples
If relevant, give an example of the search query or behavior you would like.

## Alternatives
Have you considered any other way to solve the same problem?

## Additional context
Add screenshots, examples, links, or anything else that may help.
